verdict.rationale: Amazon SES exposes an API (API v2 reference docs), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence shows one can be downloaded. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file and Markdown docs are documentation formats, not an API specification, so they are adjacent at most and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
